import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint, QRect, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QIcon, QIconEngine, QPainter, QPixmap, QRegion
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget
python.setup:
class GlyphEngine(QIconEngine):
    def __init__(self, glyph):
        super().__init__()
        self._glyph = glyph
    def clone(self):
        return GlyphEngine(self._glyph)
    def pixmap(self, size, mode, state):
        pm = QPixmap(size)
        pm.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
        renderer = fluentqt.FontIcon(self._glyph)
        renderer.setIconSize(min(size.width(), size.height()))
        renderer.setEnabled(mode != QIcon.Mode.Disabled)
        renderer.resize(size)
        painter = QPainter(pm)
        renderer.render(painter, QPoint(), QRegion(), QWidget.RenderFlag.DrawChildren)
        painter.end()
        return pm
    def paint(self, painter, rect, mode, state):
        dpr = max(1, round(painter.device().devicePixelRatioF())) if painter.device() else 1
        painter.drawPixmap(rect, self.pixmap(rect.size() * dpr, mode, state))

control = fluentqt.CommandBar(%PARENT%)
def make_command(text, glyph):
    action = QAction(text, control)
    action.setIcon(QIcon(GlyphEngine(glyph)))
    return action

add_action = make_command("New", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Add)
add_action.setPriority(QAction.Priority.HighPriority)
edit_action = make_command("Edit", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Edit)
share_action = make_command("Share", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Share)
separator = QAction(control)
separator.setSeparator(True)
pin_action = make_command("Pin", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Pin)
pin_action.setCheckable(True)
delete_action = make_command("Delete", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Delete)
delete_action.setPriority(QAction.Priority.LowPriority)
for action in (add_action, edit_action, share_action, separator, pin_action, delete_action):
    control.addPrimaryAction(action)
control.addSecondaryAction(make_command("Settings", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Settings))
control.addSecondaryAction(make_command("Help", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Info))
